note: Spec-pinned fixtures for SOLANA-B1-TRANSFER-FEE-NODE-1 (research/solana/B1-TRANSFER-FEE-BUILD-SPEC-2026-10-01.md section 6, clauses D1-D4 pinned by #2166). F1-F4 reuse the Token-2022 program's own transfer-fee test numbers verbatim (D4: calculate_fee_min, calculate_fee_max, test_transfer_fee_config/epoch_fee, calculate_fee_zero). F5 reproduces the Kora GHSA-725g advisory arithmetic (D5) via PR #378's before/after (D6). F5's maximum fee is a stated assumption: the advisory does not give one (D5), so any cap of 50 or more reproduces it (stated as 1,000,000). output_payload is filled by fill-fixture-payloads.mjs and golden_hash by golden-parity.test.mjs --update; spec_pins carry the hand-derived expected values from the spec and are asserted by the proptest, so the corpus is NOT a round-trip self-test.

output_payload.note: Fee arithmetic ports the Token-2022 transfer-fee extension: ceiling(amount * bps / 10,000) capped at maximum_fee, computed in 128-bit intermediates, with the newer schedule applying from its epoch on.
